messages:
maria: quick heads-up — offline replay (sampled prod traces) shows a 8-12% increase in 95th when batch sizes climb >30 in the new queue-priors rollout :eyes:
cheng: can you paste the small trace id and a profiler dump? is this happening on a particular model/kernel combo?
alex: here's a tiny excerpt from the trace + perf counters i grabbed while reproducing locally:
```
trace: trace-2026-03-15-09-42.json
seq_len=1024 batch_est=40
kernel_choice: fused_matmul -> fallback_gemm (switch at step ~6)
kernel_time_ms: 16.2 -> 24.7
kv_cache_hits: 86% -> 52% during warmup window
kv_miss_spike_count: 0 -> 12
backpressure_clamp: target_tokens=512 actual_tokens_alloc=784
```
sam: interesting — that `actual_tokens_alloc` jump smells like the token-budget clamp logic not accounting for queued-prefetch reservations after the priors change. if workers think they can allocate 784 tokens they'll form bigger batches and push kernel onto slower path.
jonah: proposed quick A/B: run replay harness with two policies (queue-priors-v1 vs queue-priors-v2) holding all else equal, collect 95/99 lat and cost-per-token. small command to run locally: 
```
replay-harness --trace traces/trace-2026-03-15-09-42.json \
  --policy queue-priors-v1 --token-budget 512 --out ab_v1.json && \
replay-harness --trace traces/trace-2026-03-15-09-42.json \
  --policy queue-priors-v2 --token-budget 512 --out ab_v2.json
```
maria: can you also enable kernel-selection logging for the run? `--log kernel_choice:verbose` — want to see flip frequency.
cheng: will run two short ABs on a small shard now (30m each). assigning myself. filing issue RED-3312 to track. @alex can you drop your perf snippet into the ticket? :thumbsup:
alex: pasted into RED-3312. note: i also saw a small regression in KV warmup heuristics after the last prefetch patch — warmup windows are slightly shorter which increases initial miss rate. might be compounding.
perf-bot: AB run complete (shard=small-spot, duration=30m) — summary:
- queue-priors-v1: 95p=112ms, cost/unit=1.00
- queue-priors-v2: 95p=121ms (+7.9%), cost/unit=0.91 (-9%)
- kernel-flips/v2: 1.8x higher than v1; kv_miss_rate/v2: +14%
(see /replays/ab_v1.json and /replays/ab_v2.json)
sam: tradeoff looks like lower cost but worse tail — expected. need to decide SLO vs unit-cost. suggestion: tune token_budget downward for v2 or add a soft cap on batch formation when kernel flips are frequent.
maria: agree. next steps: (1) cheng finish 2nd shard AB and attach logs to RED-3312, (2) eng-runtime to experiment with `--soft_batch_cap=32` and rerun, (3) consider small fix to token-budget clamp to subtract prefetch reservations before allocation.
jonah: i'll add a small eval harness job to run overnight across 10 traces and summarize delta.
cheng: running now, ETA ~45m. will update RED-3312 with full logs + kernel_choice timeline.
maria: thanks everyone — filing RFC/PR after we have full AB across traces. leaving this thread pinned to RED-3312.
